mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 1.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, above 105 indicates a growing supply of goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, above $500 billion indicates a growing demand for goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high retail sales (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, above 2% and a decrease in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, below 250 indicates a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate and low consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate, as measured by PAYEMS, above 150,000 and a low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, above $19 trillion indicates a growing demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high GDP (t-test p > 0.05).
